title: Domogreen Research Platform
tagline: Research collaboration backend (Flask V1 → DRF V2)
intro: Two backend iterations for a European research company: an initial Flask backend (V1) later migrated and re-architected into a DRF-based V2.
summary: V1 delivered a working Flask REST API with Firebase Auth and a Firestore → PostgreSQL migration. V2 re-architected the platform using Django REST Framework, JWT auth, and a modular, layered design. The project was deprecated before production; architectural lessons were retained.
features: Flask REST API with Firebase Auth → PostgreSQL migration
Chat creation, editing, and collaboration flows
V2: DRF with JWT, modular apps, repository/service layering

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Two successive backend iterations for a European research company. V1 (Flask) delivered the first workable backend using Firebase Auth and Firestore and migrated to PostgreSQL; V2 (DRF) introduced a modular architecture with JWT auth and service/repository layers.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a secure collaboration backend with role-based access, messaging, and integration points for AI-assisted workflows.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Led backend work across both versions: designed API endpoints, performed data migrations, implemented RBAC and chat features (V1); re-architected into DRF with JWT, serializers, and layered services (V2).

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Flask API and migration paths (V1); DRF modular apps, JWT auth, layered repositories/services, and serializers/views (V2). Containerized with Docker for deployability.

sections.title: Challenges & Solutions
sections.body: Addressed datastore scalability by moving from Firestore to PostgreSQL; managed code complexity with strict layering and modularization in V2.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Delivered an initial functional backend and a stronger architectural blueprint. Platform later deprecated; lessons carried into newer backends.

confidentialNotes: Deprecated project; retain only architectural takeaways.
